_about: VizDOM session config for the Windows Calculator demo — fully distributed: detector, capture and actuator all run as gRPC services (start them first; see README.md). Replace 'localhost' with the host running each service.
_note_focus: window_title names the app under test (ADR-021). window_scope crops the capture to that window ON THE CAPTURE SERVICE, so the DOM contains only the Calculator - and it works wherever the window is, including a second monitor whose screen coordinates are negative. Set window_scope=false for a whole-screen DOM (then use focus_before_capture=true, or the test's `Bring App To Front`, to make sure the app is visible).
_note_grounding: desc= fallbacks in calculator_locators.resource resolve with the model-free lexical tier first; add "slm" for paraphrase support (needs Ollama).
